ModMetaData.name: Colony Command
ModMetaData.author: jtj9817
ModMetaData.description:
Search, filter and sort the colonist bar at the top of the screen.
Name search, status filters (drafted, injured, idle), a skill filter and sorting, all on the vanilla colonist bar, without leaving the map.
UI only: it changes what the bar shows, never your colonists. It stores nothing in your save games and can be added or removed at any time.
Requires RimWorld 1.6. No DLC and no other mods required.
